scenario_confirmation_interactions.question: Should the CR lifecycle cover remote-main refresh, CR branch creation/publication, and post-merge cleanup?
scenario_confirmation_interactions.recommendation: cover the complete journey with fail-closed destructive steps
scenario_confirmation_interactions.user_response: 开启cr时从远端主分支拉取最新代码，创建cr分支，然后提交推送到远程分支，然后将远程分支合并到后将分支删除掉
scenario_confirmation_interactions.confirmed_understanding: The core open-publish-post-merge-cleanup journey is confirmed; tool, paired-repository, merge-proof, and commit boundaries remain CP2 decisions.
